title: Here Be Monsters: What Do You Still Need to Know When Agents Do the Work?
script:
Software engineer Adrian Quesada warns that AI agents are changing how we build software.
These agents can now independently navigate codebases and generate pull requests.
Developers are shifting from primary authors to editors of AI-generated work.
Quesada notes this creates a dangerous gap in our mental models of complex systems.
When debugging fails, you might lack the deep context required to fix critical errors.
The source article highlights that automated tools often mask underlying system fragility.
Could you reliably debug a system you never wrote?
